datasets.name: answers_q1_population_stats
queryLines:
-- Q1 tiles: mean and sample standard deviation of US population, 2013 to 2018.
SELECT
  year_from,
  year_to,
  n_years,
  is_complete,
  population_mean,
  population_stddev_samp,
  population_stddev_pop,
  population_min,
  population_max
FROM quest_gold.population_stats_2013_2018

datasets.name: answers_q2_series_best_year
queryLines:
-- Q2 table: best year per series. Sector, unit and partial-year filters sit above it.
SELECT
  series_id,
  series_label,
  sector_name,
  measure_text,
  duration_text,
  unit_of_measure,
  has_quarterly_data,
  best_year,
  best_year_value_sum,
  quarters_in_best_year,
  is_partial_year,
  tied_year_count
FROM quest_gold.series_best_year
ORDER BY series_id

datasets.name: answers_q3_prs30006032_q01
queryLines:
-- Q3: PRS30006032 Q01 value and US population by year. population is NULL where DataUSA has
-- no value (2020, and every year outside the ACS range).
SELECT
  year,
  value,
  unit_of_measure,
  population,
  has_population
FROM quest_gold.prs30006032_q01_with_population
ORDER BY year

datasets.name: dq_checks_latest
queryLines:
-- Every check of the latest validate run, problems first.
WITH latest AS (
  SELECT max_by(run_id, checked_at) AS run_id FROM quest_ops.dq_checks
)
SELECT
  c.run_id,
  c.check_code,
  c.table_name,
  c.layer,
  c.severity,
  c.status,
  c.observed_value,
  c.threshold,
  c.failing_rows,
  c.details,
  c.checked_at
FROM quest_ops.dq_checks AS c
JOIN latest AS l
  ON l.run_id = c.run_id
ORDER BY
  CASE c.status WHEN 'error' THEN 0 WHEN 'fail' THEN 1 WHEN 'warn' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,
  c.check_code,
  c.table_name

datasets.name: dq_ingest_runs
queryLines:
-- Runs timeline: one row per ingest run with its duration and counts.
SELECT
  run_id,
  started_at,
  status,
  trigger,
  code_version,
  timestampdiff(SECOND, started_at, ended_at) AS duration_s,
  versions_landed,
  pointers_flipped,
  files_skipped_fingerprint,
  files_failed,
  error_message
FROM quest_ops.ingest_runs
ORDER BY started_at DESC

datasets.name: dq_run_file_actions
queryLines:
-- Per-file actions: what each run did with each file (skipped, new version, same hash, ...).
SELECT
  r.started_at AS run_started_at,
  f.run_id,
  f.source,
  f.file_name,
  f.action,
  f.pointer_flipped,
  f.http_status,
  f.bytes,
  f.error
FROM quest_ops.ingest_run_files AS f
JOIN quest_ops.ingest_runs AS r
  ON r.run_id = f.run_id
ORDER BY run_started_at DESC, f.source, f.file_name

datasets.name: dq_quarantine_by_reason
queryLines:
-- Quarantined rows by silver table and reason. Every silver table is listed, so a 0 is shown
-- rather than an empty chart. A row with two reasons counts once per reason.
WITH quarantine AS (
  SELECT 'bls_pr_observations' AS table_name, dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_observations_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bls_pr_series', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_series_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bls_pr_class', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_class_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bls_pr_duration', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_duration_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bls_pr_footnote', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_footnote_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bls_pr_measure', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_measure_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bls_pr_period', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_period_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bls_pr_seasonal', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_seasonal_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'bls_pr_sector', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.bls_pr_sector_quarantine
  UNION ALL SELECT 'datausa_population', dq_reasons FROM quest_silver.datausa_population_quarantine
),
reasons AS (
  SELECT table_name, explode(dq_reasons) AS reason FROM quarantine
),
tables AS (
  SELECT explode(array(
    'bls_pr_observations', 'bls_pr_series', 'bls_pr_class', 'bls_pr_duration', 'bls_pr_footnote',
    'bls_pr_measure', 'bls_pr_period', 'bls_pr_seasonal', 'bls_pr_sector', 'datausa_population'
  )) AS table_name
)
SELECT
  t.table_name,
  coalesce(r.reason, '(none)') AS reason,
  count(r.reason) AS quarantined_rows
FROM tables AS t
LEFT JOIN reasons AS r
  ON r.table_name = t.table_name
GROUP BY t.table_name, r.reason
ORDER BY quarantined_rows DESC, t.table_name

datasets.name: dq_expectation_pass_rates
queryLines:
-- Expectation pass rates of the latest pipeline update that reported any, from the published
-- event log. A no-op update recomputes nothing and reports no expectations.
WITH progress AS (
  SELECT
    origin.update_id AS update_id,
    timestamp,
    details:flow_progress:data_quality:expectations AS expectations
  FROM quest_ops.pipeline_event_log
  WHERE event_type = 'flow_progress'
    AND details:flow_progress:data_quality:expectations IS NOT NULL
),
latest AS (
  SELECT max_by(update_id, timestamp) AS update_id FROM progress
),
results AS (
  SELECT explode(from_json(
    p.expectations,
    'array<struct<name: STRING, dataset: STRING, passed_records: BIGINT, failed_records: BIGINT>>'
  )) AS e
  FROM progress AS p
  JOIN latest AS l
    ON l.update_id = p.update_id
)
SELECT
  e.dataset AS dataset,
  e.name AS expectation,
  sum(e.passed_records) AS passed_records,
  sum(e.failed_records) AS failed_records,
  try_divide(sum(e.passed_records), sum(e.passed_records) + sum(e.failed_records)) AS pass_rate
FROM results
GROUP BY e.dataset, e.name
ORDER BY pass_rate, dataset, expectation

datasets.name: dq_freshness
queryLines:
-- Freshness per served file: days since the source's Last-Modified and since ingest last
-- checked it. validate warns (STALE_SOURCE) when pr.data.1.AllData passes 100 days.
SELECT
  source,
  file_name,
  status,
  http_last_modified,
  datediff(current_date(), http_last_modified) AS days_since_modified,
  updated_at AS pointer_updated_at,
  datediff(current_date(), updated_at) AS days_since_pointer_update
FROM quest_ops.file_state
ORDER BY days_since_modified DESC NULLS LAST, source, file_name

datasets.name: explorer_series_options
queryLines:
-- Filter options for the Explorer: sector, measure and duration pick exactly one series.
SELECT DISTINCT sector_name, measure_text, duration_text
FROM quest_gold.series_best_year

datasets.name: explorer_series_values
queryLines:
-- Explorer line chart: one series, picked by the sector, measure and duration filters.
-- Quarterly rows only: Q05 is the annual value and would plot as a fifth quarter.
SELECT
  concat(series_id, ', ', unit_of_measure) AS series,
  series_id,
  series_label,
  unit_of_measure,
  period_start_date,
  year,
  period,
  value,
  is_revised
FROM quest_gold.productivity_observations
WHERE sector_name = :sector
  AND measure_text = :measure
  AND duration_text = :duration
  AND NOT is_annual_average
ORDER BY period_start_date
